criteria.passage: I’d first get the story as clearly as I can by asking a few targeted questions, like roughly when they cancelled, how they did it, and whether they saw any confirmation.
criteria.rationale: This explicitly shows the candidate would ask relevant questions to understand the issue and gather needed information.

criteria.passage: Then I’d check our internal records to verify what’s actually on the account — cancellation status, logs, and any notes — instead of assuming the payment history tells the whole story.
criteria.rationale: This clearly distinguishes verified account records from assumptions and shows an evidence-based approach to assessing what happened.

criteria.passage: I’d stick to the information I’m allowed to access and wouldn’t ask for extra sensitive details unless there was a clear, approved reason.
criteria.rationale: This demonstrates collecting only appropriate and authorised information, with restraint around sensitive details.

annotation.annotation_notes: The answer provides direct evidence for all three information-gathering competencies in the scenario.
